title: Orka.ai focused Groq regression — G050 G053 G056 G063 G064
note: Five-case regression batch covering deterministic top-N ranking, filter-only identifiers, item-record counts, completed purchases by country, and units sold by product.

cases.question: Show the top three customers by number of completed orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(*) AS completed_order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY completed_order_count DESC, c.customer_name LIMIT 3;

cases.question: Show all orders placed by customer ID 2.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, status FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 2 ORDER BY order_date, order_id;

cases.question: For each order, show its ID and number of item records.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_record_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY order_id;

cases.question: Count successful purchases by customer country.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS successful_purchases FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country;

cases.question: Show total items sold by product name.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY p.product_name;
